summary: This article is a Bulbapedia encyclopedic entry covering Brandon, the chief Frontier Brain and Pyramid King of the Battle Pyramid in the Pokémon anime. It documents his background, battle history against Ash Ketchum and Paul, known Pokémon team members, manga presence, and voice acting credits.

data.context: Awakened after Pokémon Hunter J destroyed its sealing pillars, rampaging through Snowpoint City and taking control of the legendary giants until calmed when Brandon saved it from petrification.
Remained at the Snowpoint Temple alongside Regice and Registeel to serve as the new pillars protecting Regigigas.

data.subject: Brandon
data.fact: Brandon is the Frontier Brain and chief of the Battle Frontier's Battle Pyramid, awarding the Brave Symbol to Trainers who defeat him.

data.subject: Brandon
data.fact: Brandon is the strongest of all Frontier Brains and the first Trainer in the animated series to have officially caught and trained a Legendary Pokémon.

data.subject: Reggie and Paul
data.fact: Brandon defeated Reggie in battle, prompting Reggie to retire from competitive battling to become a Pokémon Breeder, and inspiring Paul's obsession with strength.

data.subject: Battle Pyramid Location
data.fact: Trainers could only discover the location of the Battle Pyramid after acquiring the other six Frontier Symbols.

data.subject: Battle Frontier Hall of Fame
data.fact: Defeating Brandon earned Ash a place in the Frontier Battle Hall of Fame and an offer to become a Frontier Brain, which Ash declined.

data.subject: Regigigas and Snowpoint Temple
data.fact: Centuries ago, Regigigas saved Snowpoint City from a volcanic eruption before going to sleep sealed inside Snowpoint Temple.
